Reporting scope distinguishes whole-jurisdiction observations from named parts. Missing legacy scope is not assumed to cover the whole electorate; observations are not summed.

Yes-vote direction follows the question wording. Advisory results express voter sentiment; they do not by themselves enact a restriction or authorize a project.
